chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad al-Ash'ari, from Abdullah ibn Aamir, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Fazalat ibn Ayoub, from Hammad ibn Uthman, who said:
I asked him (peace be upon him) about the voluntary prayers during the day, so he mentioned that he prays eight rak'at before Dhuhr and eight after it.
ai.seo_question: How many voluntary rak'at should be prayed before and after Dhuhr?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi highlights the established Sunnah of performing eight voluntary rak'at surrounding the Dhuhr prayer, a practice deeply rooted in the traditions of the Ahl al-Bayt. It underscores the importance of consistent, structured nafl prayers as a means of spiritual refinement and devotion outside the obligatory framework.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Abdullah Bin Aamir, from Ali Bin Mahziyar, from Fazalat Bin Ayoub, from Hammad Bin Usman who said,
‘I asked himasws about the voluntary (Salāts) of the daytime. So heasws mentioned that heasws tends to pray eight Rak’at before Al-Zohr, and eight after it’.
en.sarwar: 9. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad al-Ash’ariy has narrated from ‘Abd Allah ibn ‘Amir from Ali ibn Mahziyar from Fadalah ibn Ayyub from Hammad ibn ‘Uthaman who has said the following: “I once asked him (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about optional Salah (prayer) during the day. He (the Imam) said, ‘He performs eight Rak‘at before al-Dhuhr and eight after al-Dhuhr.’”
